verses.2: When he came there, the prophet gave him what was given to him at the time he arrived at the house of Sheba.
verses.3: May God have mercy on me, as You do in Your kindness. May Your great compassion forgive my sins.
verses.4: May He cleanse me from my sins and impurities.
verses.5: For my sins, I know them well; my faults are always against me.
verses.6: I have sinned alone, and I have done evil in your eyes. But may I be justified by your words, so that I may receive your judgment.
verses.7: In my sins and in my faults, O Mother, I am destroyed.
verses.8: Indeed, you desire peace and wisdom. Please enlighten me with your wisdom.
verses.9: He will forgive me in time, and he will purify me from my sins. From the ice and snow of oblivion…
verses.10: Let me hear your laughter and joy, so that my soul will be filled with happiness.
verses.11: Your faces are hidden from sin and all its tricks.
verses.12: A pure heart was created for me by God, and a new spirit was given to my being.
verses.13: Do not throw me away from your presence. Your holy spirit, do not take it away from me.
verses.14: She returned to me her kind words of comfort, and her generous spirit helped me.
verses.15: Let the wicked follow your ways, and let their sins return upon them.
verses.16: Save me from these troubles, O God! O Lord of salvation, please grant me justice according to your laws.
verses.17: My lips will open, and my mouth will speak your words.
verses.18: For you will not offer sacrifices, and you will not desire to ascend to heaven.
verses.19: The glory of God is a breath that can be extinguished; the heart that is filled with devotion will be destroyed. But God will not be extinguished.
verses.20: May your desire be fulfilled; may Zion be built anew, and Jerusalem be restored.
verses.21: Then you shall seek out the true idols above, and they will be destroyed. Then they will rise up against your idols.
